verified_structure.functional_reading: central hollow/socket supports the vertical staff/hampe of the Abydos Osiris fetish; four lions form a protective base composition
verified_structure.relic_identity_context: Abydos tradition identifies the associated Osiris relic as the head; this is supported by bibliographic indexing of Barguet under KOPF/head and by later summaries of the Abydos reliquary tradition.

comparative_controls.E33393_1_4: bronze four-lion bases of the same functional type, useful for morphology but not physical mates of E 11072
comparative_controls.perdrizet_old_interpretation: four Fouquet examples were once interpreted as furniture feet; later comparison with E 11072 and relief iconography supports identification as Abydos fetish bases

primary_source_status.reason: A directly accessible scan of Barguet pp. 153-155 was not obtained in this run. Search located bibliographic records and an unrelated RdE 9 extract, plus later scholarly sources explicitly citing Barguet's E 11072 identification.
